_what: The judging runs whose output the published graph carries, each a prov:Activity in the claim export (plan 8.1e item 4: one provenance idiom). A claim's reader stays its claim:reader agent; the run that produced it is prov:wasGeneratedBy; the models are prov:SoftwareAgent. Each run's per-item trail is in ontology/provenance/ under 'trail'.
